name: kyuz0 Strix Halo 8060S Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-BF16 ROCm 6.4.4 64k pp2048
methodology: kyuz0 amd-strix-halo-toolboxes llama-bench sweep (results.json generated 2026-05-18, Fedora 43 kernel 6.19.12-200, llama.cpp build 1a68ec937 / b9193). ROCm 6.4.4, -fa 1 -ngl 99 --mmap 0. Long-context cell: context depth 65536 tokens, prompt processing of 2048 tokens. ONE request, batch size 1, so the number is per-request, not aggregate across concurrent requests. Mean of the repeated runs; std 1.31 tok/s. Model file 64.6 GiB, 34.66 B params, quant BF16.
notes: Not in the earlier kyuz0 filing, which covered only the default-context pp512/tg128 cells. Same results.json, the longctx32768 and longctx65536 rows.
